title: Abode Bricks & Ingots
description: This project adds the Abode brick and ingot shapes but with the vanilla color palette.
body:
Bored of Vanilla Minecraft's brick and ingot shapes? This pack may be for you! This resource pack's purpose is to provide a variation on the vanilla bricks and ingots, utilizing the Abode Resource Pack's shape while retaining the vanilla Minecraft palette.
